en: Black‑and‑white view of a large stone castle-like complex on a hill, partially obscured by leafy trees in the foreground. The main structure has steep, tiled roofs, multi‑story rectangular towers with small windows, and an inner courtyard enclosed by walls. A smaller town with houses and terraced gardens lies below the fortification. The central tower has a small spire topped by a cross, indicating a chapel or religious element within the complex. The overall style is Central European and medieval/early modern.
